answer: Make each agent identity earn its price: a new agent starts with a zero-score inlet to the reputation market and must complete small verifiable jobs (comet-like short bursts of useful work, checked by peers who stake tokens on their verdicts) before its trust score rises. Payouts and voting power scale with that work-verified score, so a sybil attacker who mass-registers thousands of fake identities collects only a ripple of negligible rewards from score-zero accounts, while burning real compute, stake deposits, and time on every fake.
